title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查~BIM-based construction clash detection
focus: 以空間預算、共用座標、碰撞規則與協調循環，在施工前消除結構與機電之間的空間衝突~Space budgets, shared coordinates, clash rules and coordination cycles that remove structure–services conflicts before construction
summary: 從樓層高度預算與管線空間出發，說明聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器如何讓各專業模型可比對，再處理硬碰撞與軟碰撞規則、模型發展程度、BCF 議題追蹤與區域簽認、4D 時空碰撞、誤報分組與模型品質、現場放樣公差，以及版本控制與資產資訊交接，並以 Crossrail 與巴黎路易威登基金會的公開資料對照。~Starting from storey-height budgets and service space, explain how federated models, shared coordinates and information containers make discipline models comparable, then cover hard and clearance clash rules, level of development, BCF issue tracking and area sign-off, 4D space–time clashes, grouping of false positives and model quality, site set-out tolerances, version control and asset-information handover, compared with public material from Crossrail and the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris.

units.anchor: 天花板內管線空間~Ceiling service void
units.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突~Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts
units.mechanism: 碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。風管斷面大且需要保溫，排水管必須依坡度下降，消防灑水支管與電纜架又各有間距要求，它們往往同時想佔用梁下方那一層最方便的空間。碰撞檢查真正的作用，是在施工前把這些搶空間的情況找出來，讓設計團隊重新分配管線層次、在梁腹開孔或調整風管斷面。~Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance. Ducts are large and need insulation, drainage pipes must fall at a gradient, and sprinkler branches and cable trays each have spacing rules, so they all compete for the same convenient layer just below the beams. The real purpose of clash detection is to expose these space conflicts before construction so the design team can re-layer the services, open beam webs or change duct sections.
units.model: 樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。0.45 m 高風管加保溫 2×0.025 m 與吊架 0.05 m 需 0.55 m，不足 0.15 m。若維持斷面積 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² 而把風管高度壓到 0.30 m，寬度需 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m。數值為教學假設。~Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams. A 0.45 m duct plus 2×0.025 m insulation and a 0.05 m hanger needs 0.55 m, 0.15 m short. Keeping the area 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² but limiting the duct to 0.30 m high needs a width of 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內；梁腹開孔要由結構工程師核算，並在模型中建立開孔物件，而不是讓管線直接穿梁。~In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone; beam web openings must be checked by the structural engineer and modelled as opening objects rather than letting services pass through beams.
units.failure: 樓高在初期為了增加樓層數被壓縮，管線空間卻沒有同步檢討，到施工圖階段才發現主風管無法通過梁下，只好降低天花板或在已澆置的梁上鑽孔；前者違反租約淨高，後者可能切斷鋼筋而需要結構補強。~Storey height squeezed early to gain floors, without a matching review of service space, reveals at shop-drawing stage that main ducts cannot pass under the beams, forcing either a lower ceiling that breaches lease clear heights or coring through cast beams that may cut reinforcement and require strengthening.
units.misconception: 碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。~Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
units.practice: 在概念設計階段就由建築、結構與機電共同訂定典型樓層的垂直空間預算圖，列為設計凍結項目；之後任何梁深或淨高變更都必須重新簽認空間預算。~At concept stage have architecture, structure and building services jointly agree a vertical space budget for typical floors and treat it as a design-freeze item; any later change to beam depth or clear height must re-sign the space budget.

units.anchor: 共用座標原點~Shared coordinate origin
units.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器~Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers
units.mechanism: 各專業通常在不同軟體、不同檔案中建模，碰撞檢查前要把它們組成聯合模型；聯合時各模型互不改動，只是疊在一起比對，Crossrail 的 BIM 經驗也強調個別模型不互相影響，必須由模型管理者確認它們彼此吻合。要能正確疊合，所有模型必須使用同一個專案原點、同一個方位角與同一個高程基準，並依 ISO 19650 的資訊容器規則命名與分割，讓每個檔案的責任人、狀態與版本都清楚。~Each discipline usually models in its own software and files, so before clash runs they are assembled into a federated model; the models are overlaid and compared without altering one another, and Crossrail's BIM lessons likewise stress that individual models do not interact and that the model steward must confirm they fit together. To overlay correctly, every model must use the same project origin, the same rotation to grid north and the same height datum, and be named and split as information containers under ISO 19650 so that each file's owner, status and revision are clear.
units.model: 旋轉誤差造成的位移 d = L·sin θ。建築長 120 m、兩模型方位差 0.5°：d = 120×sin 0.5° = 120×0.00873 ≈ 1.05 m；即使只差 0.05°，遠端仍偏約 0.10 m，足以產生大量假碰撞。單位若誤設為公尺與公釐之差，尺度相差 1,000 倍。數值為教學假設。~Offset from a rotation error d = L·sin θ. For a 120 m building with a 0.5° rotation mismatch, d = 120×sin 0.5° = 120×0.00873 ≈ 1.05 m; even 0.05° leaves about 0.10 m at the far end, enough to create many false clashes. A unit mix-up between metres and millimetres scales the model by 1,000. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。~Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs.
units.failure: 機電模型以本地原點建立而未對齊結構模型時，第一次碰撞報告可能出現數萬筆假碰撞，團隊為了消化報告而放寬容許值或關閉部分測試，真正的碰撞反而被淹沒。~An MEP model built on a local origin and not aligned to the structural model can produce tens of thousands of false clashes in the first report, and teams trying to digest it widen tolerances or switch off tests, burying the real clashes.
units.misconception: 只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。~Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically.
units.practice: BIM 執行計畫應明列專案座標系統、原點、方位角、高程基準、單位與檔案分割原則，由資訊管理者在每次聯合前執行座標檢核；未通過檢核的模型不得改為「共享」狀態。~The BIM execution plan should state the project coordinate system, origin, rotation, height datum, units and file-splitting rules, and the information manager should run the coordinate check before every federation; a model that fails cannot be moved to Shared status.

units.anchor: 碰撞規則與容許值~Clash rules and tolerances
units.title: 硬碰撞、軟碰撞與容許值設定~Hard clashes, clearance clashes and tolerance settings
units.mechanism: 硬碰撞是兩個實體幾何直接重疊，例如風管穿過梁；軟碰撞（淨距碰撞）則是物件之間的距離小於規定淨距，例如保溫層、維修空間、灑水頭下方淨空或電纜與熱水管的間隔。碰撞軟體只比對幾何與規則，所以容許值設定決定報告的意義：容許值太小會把接觸與建模誤差都報出來，太大則漏掉真正問題；保溫層、防火被覆是否建模，也會讓同一配置出現或不出現碰撞。~A hard clash is a direct overlap of two solids, such as a duct passing through a beam; a soft or clearance clash is a distance below a required clearance, such as insulation, maintenance access, sprinkler deflector clearance or separation between cables and hot-water pipes. Clash software only compares geometry against rules, so tolerance settings decide what a report means: too small a tolerance reports touching objects and modelling noise, too large misses real problems, and whether insulation or fireproofing is modelled decides whether the same layout clashes at all.
units.model: 兩支外徑 150 mm 的管線中心距 160 mm：裸管間隙 160 − 150 = 10 mm，無硬碰撞。各加 25 mm 保溫後外徑 200 mm，重疊 200 − 160 = 40 mm。若規定保溫面之間淨距 50 mm，所需中心距 200 + 50 = 250 mm，須再移開 90 mm。數值為教學假設。~Two 150 mm OD pipes at 160 mm centres: bare gap 160 − 150 = 10 mm, no hard clash. With 25 mm insulation each the outer diameter is 200 mm and the overlap is 200 − 160 = 40 mm. A 50 mm clearance rule between insulation faces needs 200 + 50 = 250 mm centres, another 90 mm apart. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 為每一組專業配對建立碰撞矩陣，寫明硬碰撞容許值、軟碰撞淨距與排除條件（例如同系統的接頭、穿越套管），先以刻意放入的已知碰撞樣本測試規則是否抓得到；規則每次修改都要記錄版本，以免前後報告數量無法比較。~Build a clash matrix for every discipline pair stating hard-clash tolerance, clearance distances and exclusions (for example joints within one system or penetrations through sleeves), test the rules first on seeded known clashes to confirm they are caught, and version every rule change so that report counts remain comparable over time.
units.failure: 規則若未包含保溫層或維修淨空，報告顯示零碰撞，現場卻發現保溫後的管線互相擠壓、閥門無法操作，只能拆除重排；反之把同系統接頭也列為碰撞，報告數量膨脹到無法審查。~Rules that omit insulation or maintenance clearance show zero clashes, yet on site insulated pipes are squeezed together and valves cannot be operated, forcing removal and re-routing; conversely, counting joints within one system as clashes inflates reports beyond any chance of review.
units.misconception: 碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。~A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site.
units.practice: 碰撞矩陣與容許值應在 BIM 執行計畫中定案並由各專業設計負責人簽認；保溫、防火被覆、維修與操作淨空必須以實體或淨空體積建模，不能只寫在說明中。~Finalise the clash matrix and tolerances in the BIM execution plan with sign-off from each discipline lead; insulation, fireproofing and maintenance or operating clearances must be modelled as solids or clearance volumes, not left in notes.

units.anchor: 鋼筋與預埋件密度~Rebar and embed congestion
units.title: 模型發展程度與細部碰撞~Level of development and detail clashes
units.mechanism: 模型能找出什麼碰撞，取決於模型發展程度（LOD）或資訊需求程度：LOD 300 的梁柱只有外形，看不到鋼筋、預埋件與鋼構接頭板，因此梁柱接頭的鋼筋擁擠、錨栓與套管衝突要到 LOD 350 或 400 的製造模型才會出現。BIMForum 的 LOD 規範依元素分類說明每個等級應包含的內容，專案應依協調目的指定每個階段需要的程度，而不是一律要求最高等級。~What clashes a model can reveal depends on its level of development or level of information need: LOD 300 beams and columns show only outer shape, without reinforcement, embeds or steel connection plates, so rebar congestion at beam–column joints and conflicts between anchors and sleeves only appear in LOD 350 or 400 fabrication models. The BIMForum LOD Specification describes what each level contains element by element, and a project should specify the level needed at each stage for its coordination purpose rather than demanding the highest level everywhere.
units.model: 梁寬 600 mm、保護層 40 mm、箍筋 13 mm、一層 8 支 32 mm 主筋：淨間距 = (600 − 2×40 − 2×13 − 8×32)/7 = 238/7 = 34.0 mm，大於 ACI 318 的下限 max(32 mm, 25 mm, 4/3×20 mm) = 32 mm。若再加 1 支成 9 支：(494 − 288)/8 ≈ 25.8 mm，不合格。數值為教學假設。~Beam width 600 mm, cover 40 mm, 13 mm stirrups and one layer of eight 32 mm bars: clear spacing = (600 − 2×40 − 2×13 − 8×32)/7 = 238/7 = 34.0 mm, above the ACI 318 minimum of max(32 mm, 25 mm, 4/3×20 mm) = 32 mm. Adding a ninth bar gives (494 − 288)/8 ≈ 25.8 mm, which fails. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在梁柱接頭、轉換梁與機電套管密集區建立鋼筋與預埋件模型，以碰撞檢查找出鋼筋與套管、錨栓、預力管的衝突，再以淨間距規則檢查擁擠度；結果交由結構設計者確認，必要時以 1:1 樣品或局部模型試排。~Model reinforcement and embeds at beam–column joints, transfer beams and dense sleeve zones, run clash checks between bars and sleeves, anchors and post-tensioning ducts, then check congestion with clear-spacing rules; have the structural designer confirm the results and trial-place difficult joints with a full-size mock-up or local model when needed.
units.failure: 只用外形模型做協調，報告看似乾淨，施工時卻發現接頭鋼筋與鋼骨柱的螺栓、灌漿管互相阻擋，混凝土無法填實而形成蜂窩；事後補強或改設計往往拖累整個樓層的工期。~Coordinating with shape-only models gives a clean-looking report, yet during construction joint bars block steel-column bolts and grout tubes so concrete cannot consolidate and honeycombs form; the subsequent repair or redesign often delays the whole floor cycle.
units.misconception: 所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。~Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful.
units.practice: 在資訊需求文件中依區域指定 LOD：一般樓板與牆面維持 LOD 300，鋼筋擁擠接頭、機電密集走廊與機房要求 LOD 350 至 400，並把這些高細度區域列為協調會議的固定議程。~In the information requirements, assign LOD by area: keep typical slabs and walls at LOD 300, require LOD 350 to 400 for congested joints, dense service corridors and plant rooms, and make these high-detail areas a standing item on the coordination agenda.

units.anchor: BCF 議題清單~BCF issue list
units.title: 協調週期、議題追蹤與區域簽認~Coordination cycles, issue tracking and area sign-off
units.mechanism: 碰撞檢查不是一次性的動作，而是每週或每兩週重複的協調循環：各專業上傳最新模型到共用資料環境，資訊管理者聯合模型並執行碰撞測試，把結果分組成議題，以 BCF 格式記錄視點、相關元素 GUID 與責任人，在協調會議中決定誰改、怎麼改，下一輪再確認是否關閉。某區域的議題清空並經各專業簽認後，才放行製造圖與預製。~Clash detection is not a one-off act but a coordination cycle repeated weekly or fortnightly: each discipline uploads its latest model to the common data environment, the information manager federates and runs the tests, groups results into issues and records them in BCF with viewpoints, element GUIDs and owners, the coordination meeting decides who changes what, and the next round confirms closure. Only when an area's issues are cleared and signed off by every discipline are its fabrication drawings and prefabrication released.
units.model: 議題數 N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k，穩態 N* = 每週新增/解決率。取 N₀ = 600、每週解決 r = 35%、每週新增 40：N* = 40/0.35 ≈ 114。要降到 150 以下需 (600−114)×0.65^k ≤ 36，即 0.65^k ≤ 0.074，k ≥ ln 0.074/ln 0.65 ≈ 6.04，取 7 週。數值為教學假設。~Open issues N_k = N* + (N₀ − N*)(1−r)^k with steady state N* = new per week / resolution rate. With N₀ = 600, r = 35% per week and 40 new issues per week: N* = 40/0.35 ≈ 114. Falling below 150 needs (600−114)×0.65^k ≤ 36, so 0.65^k ≤ 0.074 and k ≥ ln 0.074/ln 0.65 ≈ 6.04, giving 7 weeks. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以 BCF 或議題追蹤平台統計每週新增、關閉與逾期議題，畫出每個區域的燃盡曲線並與製造圖送審時程對照；區域簽認表需有各專業負責人簽名與模型版本號，監造抽查已簽認區域是否確實沒有未關閉議題。~Count new, closed and overdue issues each week in BCF or the issue platform, plot a burn-down for every area against the fabrication-drawing schedule, and require each area sign-off sheet to carry the signatures of all discipline leads and the model revision numbers; the supervising engineer spot-checks that signed-off areas really have no open issues.
units.failure: 協調會議只播放碰撞畫面而沒有指定責任人與期限，議題數長期停在高檔；製造廠在區域未簽認前就依舊模型預製風管與管架，到現場才發現已改線，整批材料報廢。~Meetings that only replay clash views without naming owners and deadlines leave issue counts high for months; a fabricator that prefabricates ducts and racks from an old model before area sign-off finds on site that routes have changed and scraps the whole batch.
units.misconception: 碰撞報告產出後，軟體會自動決定哪個專業必須修改。~Once the clash report is produced, the software decides which discipline must change.
units.practice: 以區域簽認作為預製放行的保留點：未經建築、結構、機電與消防負責人簽認的區域，不得發出製造圖或材料訂單；每個議題都要有單一責任人與到期日。~Make area sign-off the hold point for releasing prefabrication: no fabrication drawings or material orders may be issued for an area until the architecture, structure, MEP and fire leads have signed it off, and every issue has a single owner and a due date.

units.title: 時空碰撞與施工順序模擬~Space–time clashes and sequence simulation
units.mechanism: 空間沒有碰撞，不代表施工可行：兩組工班若在同一時間需要同一區域，或塔吊吊運路徑穿過正在組立的支撐架，都是時空碰撞。4D 模型把模型元素與排程活動連結，依時間播放施工順序，並可加入工作空間、吊裝範圍與臨時結構，檢查同一時段是否有空間重疊。Crossrail 在法靈頓站以約 12 萬英鎊做 3D 排程分析，促成約 800 萬英鎊風險預備金的釋出，顯示排程協調的價值。~A model without spatial clashes is not necessarily buildable: two crews needing the same area at once, or a tower-crane lift path crossing temporary shoring under erection, are space–time clashes. A 4D model links model elements to schedule activities, plays the construction sequence over time and can include workspaces, lifting zones and temporary works to detect overlaps in the same period. At Farringdon station Crossrail spent about £120k on 3D schedule analysis, which enabled about £8 million of risk contingency to be released, showing the value of schedule coordination.
units.model: 第 3 區的風管安裝排在第 10 至 18 天，天花板骨架排在第 16 至 22 天，兩者在第 16、17、18 天重疊，共 3 天。若天花板活動的總浮時只有 2 天，延後 3 天會使完工日延後 3 − 2 = 1 天；改把第 3 區分成 3a、3b 兩段交錯施工即可消除重疊。數值為教學假設。~In zone 3, duct installation runs on days 10 to 18 and ceiling framing on days 16 to 22, overlapping on days 16, 17 and 18, three days in all. If the ceiling activity has only 2 days of total float, delaying it by 3 days pushes completion by 3 − 2 = 1 day; splitting zone 3 into 3a and 3b and staggering the work removes the overlap. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以 4D 模擬逐週檢查工作空間、吊裝範圍、臨時支撐與材料堆置是否重疊，並與總承包商的三週滾動計畫比對；每月以現場照片或掃描檢查實際進度與 4D 模型是否一致，偏離時更新排程後重新模擬。~Use 4D simulation to check weekly for overlaps between workspaces, lifting zones, temporary supports and laydown areas, compare it with the main contractor's three-week look-ahead, and each month compare site photographs or scans with the 4D model, updating the schedule and re-simulating when they diverge.
units.failure: 只檢查永久構件的空間碰撞而忽略臨時支撐與吊運路徑，結果大型機電模組無法從預留開口吊入，因為開口已被先施工的管線佔用，只好拆除部分已完成工作再吊裝。~Checking only permanent elements and ignoring temporary supports and lifting routes can mean a large MEP module cannot be lifted in through its reserved opening because services installed earlier now occupy it, so finished work must be partly removed to make the lift.
units.misconception: 只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。~If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.
units.practice: 大型設備吊入路徑、臨時開口與吊裝區應建成模型物件並納入碰撞矩陣，其封閉時點列入排程；吊裝計畫本身仍須由合格吊掛工程師與工地主任依規定核准，4D 模擬只是協調工具。~Model large-equipment lift routes, temporary openings and lifting zones as objects in the clash matrix and put their closing dates in the schedule; the lifting plan itself must still be approved by a qualified lifting engineer and the site manager as the rules require, with 4D simulation serving only as a coordination tool.

units.anchor: 規則式模型檢查~Rule-based model checking
units.title: 碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質~Clash grouping, false positives and model quality
units.mechanism: 原始碰撞報告常有數千至上萬筆結果，其中大部分是同一原因重複出現，例如一根風管穿過二十根吊桿就產生二十筆。有效的審查先依元素、系統、樓層或格線分組，排除建模雜訊，再由人判斷哪些是需要設計決策的真實議題。碰撞檢查只看幾何，因此還要以規則式模型檢查補足：重複元素、未連接的管線、缺少系統分類或防火等級屬性，都會讓碰撞結果失真。~Raw clash reports often contain thousands to tens of thousands of results, most of them repeats of one cause; one duct passing twenty hanger rods produces twenty results. Effective review first groups results by element, system, level or grid, removes modelling noise, and then lets people judge which are real issues needing design decisions. Clash detection sees only geometry, so rule-based model checking must complement it: duplicate elements, unconnected pipework and missing system or fire-rating properties all distort clash results.
units.model: 原始結果 12,000 筆，依元素與區域分組成 480 組，審查確認其中 120 組為真實設計議題：以組計的精確率 120/480 = 25%，以原始筆數計僅 120/12,000 = 1%。每組審查 6 分鐘約需 480×6/60 = 48 小時；逐筆每筆 0.5 分鐘則需 12,000×0.5/60 = 100 小時。數值為教學假設。~12,000 raw results grouped by element and zone become 480 groups, of which review confirms 120 as real design issues: precision is 120/480 = 25% by group but only 120/12,000 = 1% by raw result. At 6 minutes per group, review takes 480×6/60 = 48 hours; reviewing raw results at 0.5 minutes each would take 12,000×0.5/60 = 100 hours. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次聯合前先執行規則式模型檢查（重複物件、空間未封閉、缺屬性、不合理尺寸），通過門檻（例如失敗元素少於 1%）才進入碰撞測試；分組規則與排除清單要版本化，並抽查被排除的結果，確認沒有誤刪真實問題。~Before each federation run rule-based model checks (duplicates, unclosed spaces, missing properties, implausible sizes) and allow clash testing only above a threshold such as fewer than 1% failing elements; version the grouping rules and exclusion lists and spot-check excluded results to confirm that no real problem was discarded.
units.failure: 團隊為了讓數字好看而大量標記「已核可」或擴大排除條件，管理報表顯示碰撞快速下降，真正的衝突卻被埋進排除清單，直到現場安裝才暴露。~Teams that mark results ‘approved’ en masse or widen exclusions to make numbers look good see management reports show clashes falling fast, while real conflicts are buried in exclusion lists until site installation exposes them.
units.misconception: 碰撞數量越少，代表協調品質越好。~The fewer the clashes in the report, the better the coordination.
units.practice: 協調報表應同時呈現原始數、分組數、真實議題數與逾期數，由不參與建模的協調經理抽查排除與核可紀錄；任何「核可碰撞」都要寫明理由與核可人。~Coordination reports should show raw counts, groups, real issues and overdue issues together, with a coordination manager who does not model spot-checking exclusions and approvals; every ‘approved clash’ must record its reason and approver.

units.anchor: 現場放樣與公差累積~Site set-out and tolerance stack
units.title: 現場安裝公差與模型驗證~Installation tolerances and field verification of the model
units.mechanism: 模型中相距幾公釐的兩個物件，在現場可能因放樣、預製尺寸與安裝誤差而相撞。因此協調後的模型要經由全測站或雷射掃描回到現場：先以模型座標放樣吊架與套管位置，安裝後再量測實際位置與模型比對。這一步把虛擬協調與實體施工連成閉環，也讓軟碰撞淨距有了依據：淨距應涵蓋各項誤差的合成，而不是任意的數字。~Two objects a few millimetres apart in the model can collide on site because of set-out, fabrication and installation errors. The coordinated model must therefore return to site through total stations or laser scanning: hangers and sleeves are set out from model coordinates, and after installation actual positions are measured and compared with the model. This closes the loop between virtual coordination and physical construction and gives the clearance rules a basis, since the clearance should cover the combined errors rather than an arbitrary number.
units.model: 單一物件位置誤差以平方和開根號合成：放樣 ±5 mm、預製 ±3 mm、安裝 ±10 mm，√(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm。兩個獨立安裝物件之間的相對誤差約 √2×11.6 ≈ ±16.4 mm，所以模型淨距小於約 16 mm 處現場就有明顯碰撞機率，軟碰撞規則宜取 20 至 25 mm。數值為教學假設。~Combine position errors for one object by root-sum-square: set-out ±5 mm, fabrication ±3 mm and installation ±10 mm give √(5² + 3² + 10²) = √134 ≈ ±11.6 mm. Between two independently installed objects the relative error is about √2×11.6 ≈ ±16.4 mm, so where the model gap is below about 16 mm a site clash is quite likely, and a clearance rule of 20 to 25 mm is sensible. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以機器人全測站從模型匯出點位放樣吊架、套管與預埋件，放樣後抽查實際位置；安裝完成後以雷射掃描或全測站量測關鍵管線，與模型比對並列出超過容許值的位置，作為封板前的檢查點。~Set out hangers, sleeves and embeds from model points with a robotic total station and spot-check the marks; after installation measure key services by laser scanning or total station, compare with the model and list locations beyond tolerance as a check before the ceiling closes up.
units.failure: 模型協調完美，現場卻仍用捲尺從柱面量測放樣，累積誤差讓多支管線偏移數公分，與後續施工的電纜架相撞；因為沒有安裝後量測，問題到天花板封板時才被發現。~The model is perfectly coordinated but site crews still set out with tapes from column faces, accumulated errors shift several pipes by centimetres into later cable trays, and with no post-installation survey the problem surfaces only when the ceiling is boarded.
units.misconception: 模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。~Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts.
units.practice: 規定封板前量測為保留點：天花板、管道間與牆面封板前，必須完成關鍵管線位置量測並與模型比對，偏差超過容許值者由設計與施工雙方確認處置後才能封閉。~Make pre-close-up survey a hold point: before ceilings, shafts or walls are closed, key services must be measured and compared with the model, and any deviation beyond tolerance must be resolved jointly by design and construction before closing.

units.anchor: 共用資料環境狀態~CDE states and change control
units.title: 設計變更下的模型維護~Model maintenance under design change
units.mechanism: 設計變更、送審意見與現場問題會讓模型持續修改，若沒有版本控制，碰撞檢查可能拿新版結構對舊版機電比較而得出錯誤結論。ISO 19650 把資訊容器分成作業中、共享、發布與封存等狀態：只有經過檢核並轉為共享的模型才能進入聯合，只有發布版本才能作為施工依據；每次狀態轉換都要記錄版本與核准人，讓任何一份碰撞報告都能追溯到確切的模型版本。~Design changes, review comments and site issues keep the models changing, and without version control a clash run may compare a new structure against an old MEP model and reach wrong conclusions. ISO 19650 divides information containers into work-in-progress, shared, published and archived states: only checked models moved to shared may enter federation, and only published revisions may be built from, with every state change recording the revision and approver so that any clash report can be traced to exact model versions.
units.model: 聯合模型含 12 個專業模型，若每個模型準時以當週版本上傳的機率為 90%，全部都是當週版本的機率只有 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28；訂定固定凍結時間、把準時率提高到 98% 後，機率升為 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78。數值為教學假設。~A federated model contains 12 discipline models; if each is uploaded on time with that week's revision with probability 90%, the chance that all are current is only 0.9^12 ≈ 0.28; a fixed freeze time that lifts on-time delivery to 98% raises it to 0.98^12 ≈ 0.78. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每份碰撞報告封面列出所有參與模型的檔名、版本號與狀態，資訊管理者在聯合前與共用資料環境的發布紀錄比對；設計變更單要列出受影響區域，並觸發該區域重新協調與重新簽認。~Every clash report cover lists the file name, revision and status of every model used, and the information manager checks them against the common data environment's publication record before federation; each design change notice must list affected areas and trigger re-coordination and re-sign-off of those areas.
units.failure: 變更只更新了圖說而未更新模型，或反之，使模型與圖說不一致；施工依圖說做、協調依模型做，雙方都以為自己正確，衝突到現場才出現，責任歸屬也難以釐清。~A change that updates the drawings but not the model, or the reverse, leaves the two inconsistent; construction follows the drawings while coordination follows the model, each side believes it is right, the conflict surfaces on site and responsibility is hard to establish.
units.misconception: 共用資料環境只是存放檔案的雲端資料夾。~A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files.
units.practice: 在合約中明定模型與圖說的優先順序與同步規則，訂定每週固定的模型凍結時間；設計變更通知必須同時附上更新後的模型版本，否則不得發布。~State in the contract the precedence and synchronisation rules between models and drawings and set a fixed weekly model-freeze time; a design change notice may not be issued without the updated model revision attached.

units.anchor: 資產資訊模型~Asset information model
units.title: 竣工模型與資產資訊交接~As-built models and asset-information handover
units.mechanism: 協調後的模型若在交接時只留下幾何，營運者仍找不到閥門、維修淨空與設備資料。交接應把模型轉成資產資訊模型：依資產分類賦予編碼、廠牌、型號、保固與維護週期，並保留碰撞協調中確認的維修通道與淨空。Crossrail 中央段九座主要車站每站約有 15,000 至 25,000 個資產，說明交接資料量之大，必須以資料規則自動檢查，不能只靠人工逐一核對。~If the coordinated model leaves handover with geometry only, operators still cannot find valves, maintenance clearances or equipment data. Handover should turn the model into an asset information model: assign classification codes, makes, models, warranties and maintenance intervals by asset, and keep the access routes and clearances confirmed during clash coordination. The nine main Crossrail central-section stations each had about 15,000 to 25,000 assets, showing how large handover data becomes and why it must be checked by automated data rules rather than by hand alone.
units.model: 9 站 × 每站 15,000 至 25,000 個資產 = 135,000 至 225,000 個資產；每個資產 20 項屬性時共 2.7 至 4.5 百萬筆資料。即使正確率 99.5%，仍有 0.005×2,700,000 = 13,500 至 0.005×4,500,000 = 22,500 筆錯誤。屬性數與正確率為教學假設。~9 stations × 15,000 to 25,000 assets each = 135,000 to 225,000 assets; with 20 attributes per asset that is 2.7 to 4.5 million values. Even at 99.5% accuracy there remain 0.005×2,700,000 = 13,500 to 0.005×4,500,000 = 22,500 wrong values. Attribute count and accuracy are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依交接資訊需求建立自動檢查規則（必填屬性、編碼格式、空間歸屬、與設備清單的一致性），每批交付都產出通過率報告；並抽樣到現場核對模型中的資產編號、位置與銘牌，確認竣工模型反映實際安裝，而非協調時的設計意圖。~Build automated checks from the handover information requirements (mandatory attributes, code formats, space assignment, consistency with equipment schedules), produce a pass-rate report for every delivery, and sample assets on site to compare model tags, positions and nameplates, confirming that the as-built model reflects what was installed rather than the design intent at coordination.
units.failure: 所謂竣工模型其實是最後一版協調模型，未反映現場改線，營運單位依模型打開天花板找閥門卻撲空；資產屬性缺漏使維護系統無法匯入，業主只好另外花錢重新盤點。~An ‘as-built’ model that is really the last coordination model, missing site re-routes, sends operators opening ceilings to find valves that are not there; missing asset attributes stop the maintenance system from importing data, and the owner pays again for a fresh survey.
units.misconception: 施工期間協調用的模型就等於竣工模型。~The model used for coordination during construction is the as-built model.
units.practice: 交接資訊需求要在招標時寫入合約，指定格式（例如 IFC 與 COBie）、屬性清單與驗收門檻；竣工模型須經現場抽驗與業主營運代表簽認，才能作為最後付款條件之一。~Write handover information requirements into the contract at tender, specifying formats (for example IFC and COBie), attribute lists and acceptance thresholds; the as-built model must pass site sampling and sign-off by the owner's operations representative before it counts toward final payment.

example: 設計練習：一棟 20 層建築第一次聯合碰撞檢查得到 18,000 筆原始結果，分組後成為 900 組，其中 30% 即 270 組為真實議題。若這些議題留到現場，每件需 3 人工班 2 天（3×8×2 = 48 工時），以每工時 60 美元計為 2,880 美元，再加材料 1,200 美元，每件 4,080 美元，總計 270×4,080 = 1,101,600 美元。施工前協調由 2 名協調員做 26 週、每週 40 小時、每小時 75 美元，即 2×26×40×75 = 156,000 美元，加軟硬體 30,000 美元共 186,000 美元，效益比約 1,101,600/186,000 ≈ 5.9。若其中一半議題本來就會在製造圖階段被發現，效益減半為 550,800 美元，比值約 3.0，仍值得投入。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。~Design exercise: the first federated clash run on a 20-storey building returns 18,000 raw results, grouped into 900 groups, of which 30%, or 270, are real issues. Left to site, each would need a three-person crew for two days (3×8×2 = 48 labour-hours) at US$60 per hour, US$2,880, plus US$1,200 of material, US$4,080 each and 270×4,080 = US$1,101,600 in total. Pre-construction coordination by two coordinators for 26 weeks at 40 hours a week and US$75 per hour costs 2×26×40×75 = US$156,000, plus US$30,000 for software and hardware, US$186,000 in all, a benefit ratio of about 1,101,600/186,000 ≈ 5.9. If half the issues would have been caught at shop-drawing stage anyway, the benefit halves to US$550,800 and the ratio is about 3.0, still worth the effort. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
history: 1970 年代 Charles Eastman 的建築描述系統提出以物件資料庫取代圖紙，1987 年 ArchiCAD 讓個人電腦能同時產生 2D 與 3D，1992 年「建築資訊模型」一詞出現在學術論文中。2007 年 Autodesk 收購英國 NavisWorks，其 Clash Detective 使多專業聯合模型的碰撞檢查成為營建常規；2009 年 Solibri、Tekla 與慕尼黑應用科技大學開始發展 BCF，以開放格式交換議題。英國於 2011 年要求公共工程在 2016 年達到 BIM Level 2，Crossrail 於 2008 至 2012 年建立整合資訊環境，ISO 19650 第 1、2 部則在 2018 年發布。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~In the 1970s Charles Eastman's Building Description System proposed replacing drawings with an object database; in 1987 ArchiCAD let a personal computer produce both 2D and 3D, and in 1992 the term building information model appeared in an academic paper. In 2007 Autodesk acquired the UK firm NavisWorks, whose Clash Detective made multi-discipline federated clash checking routine in construction; in 2009 Solibri, Tekla and the Munich University of Applied Sciences began developing BCF to exchange issues in an open format. In 2011 the UK required public projects to reach BIM Level 2 by 2016, Crossrail built its integrated information environment from 2008 to 2012, and ISO 19650 Parts 1 and 2 were published in 2018. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Crossrail 的共用 CAD 模型支援超過 25 個組織、同時約 450 名使用者進行 3D 設計協調~Crossrail's shared CAD model supported 3D design coordination across more than 25 organisations and about 450 users at any one time

Crossrail 中央段九座主要車站每站約有 15,000 至 25,000 個獨立資產，計畫管理超過 100 份主要合約~Each of the nine main Crossrail central-section stations had about 15,000 to 25,000 individual assets, and the programme managed over 100 main contracts
Crossrail 法靈頓站的 3D 排程分析花費約 12 萬英鎊，促成約 800 萬英鎊風險預備金的釋出~A 3D schedule analysis at Crossrail's Farringdon station cost about £120k and enabled about £8 million of risk contingency to be released

路易威登基金會的 12 片玻璃帆共約 13,500 m²，由 3,600 片彎曲玻璃組成，另有 19,000 片 Ductal 外牆板~The Fondation Louis Vuitton's 12 glass sails cover about 13,500 m² with 3,600 curved glass panels, plus 19,000 Ductal cladding panels

路易威登基金會 2008 年 3 月開工、2014 年 10 月開放，各方都在同一個 Digital Project 3D 模型上工作~The Fondation Louis Vuitton started construction in March 2008 and opened in October 2014, with all partners working on one Digital Project 3D model

Stanford 與 DPR 研究的 9,690 萬美元北加州醫療建築，以 BIM 協調機電後機電人工節省約 20% 至 30%，機械返工低於 0.2%~A US$96.9 M Northern California healthcare project studied by Stanford and DPR reported about 20% to 30% MEP labour savings and under 0.2% mechanical rework after BIM coordination
同一醫療案例報告現場安裝零衝突，約節省 6 個月工期與約 900 萬美元~The same healthcare case reported zero field installation conflicts, about 6 months of schedule savings and about US$9 M in cost savings
BCF 由 Solibri、Tekla 與慕尼黑應用科技大學於 2009 年開始發展，以 IFC GUID 指向議題相關元素~BCF development began in 2009 by Solibri, Tekla and the Munich University of Applied Sciences, referencing issue elements by IFC GUID
n 個專業兩兩比對需要 n(n−1)/2 組碰撞測試，8 個專業即 28 組~Pairwise testing of n disciplines needs n(n−1)/2 clash tests, so 8 disciplines need 28
